formative_worksheets.title: The Predict and Compare Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming scale words and two-population comparison before mean+mode.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can use scale words and compare two populations.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use scale words and compare two populations.
header.character_watermark: Lucky Lou the Loon with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Pick a likelihood word for the event.
prompts.visual_layout: Event description with five likelihood-word options to circle.

image_placeholders.description: An event prompt 'Roll a 6 on a die' for Grade 3 formative check, B&W line art. Below: 5 word boxes (impossible, unlikely, equally likely, likely, certain) to circle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_WORD at Prompt 1: keywords name the likelihood word circle task.

prompts.visual_layout: Two side-by-side columns showing Class A and Class B counts and a yes-or-no answer line.

image_placeholders.description: A two-column compare illustration for Grade 3 formative check, B&W line art. Class A: hockey 6, soccer 3. Class B: hockey 5, soccer 5. Below: 'Same favourite?' answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_COMPARE at Prompt 2: keywords name the side-by-side columns showing favourite counts.

prompts.answer_key: No (Class A favourite = hockey; Class B = tied).

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 3 formative check, B&W line art.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.
